id.title: ID
id.description: SHA-256 of (politician, transaction_date, asset_name, amount_min, amount_max, source_id). Unique per row — changes if source_id changes.

source_id.title: Source document ID
source_id.description: The source PTR's document id plus the row's ordinal within it (<ptr_uuid>|<row_index>). Identifies exactly which document and line produced this row.

content_hash.title: Content hash
content_hash.description: SHA-256 of (politician, transaction_date, asset_name, type, amount_min, amount_max, owner) — source_id excluded. Rows sharing this within the same document are legitimate separate tranches; rows sharing it across different documents are the same real-world transaction reported twice. Never used to drop or merge rows — see actor README.

filing_type.title: Filing type
filing_type.description: Read from the PTR's own "(Amendment N)" label. Null only when the source page didn't expose a label — never inferred from duplicate documents.

amendment_number.title: Amendment number
amendment_number.description: The N in "(Amendment N)". Null for originals and for anything the source doesn't label.

parse_status.title: Parse status
parse_status.description: Always 'ok' on this actor — the Senate source is HTML, not a PDF, so there's no scanned/unreadable-filing case here. Present for schema parity with the House actor, whose PDF parser can emit a 'scanned_unparsed' placeholder row for a filing it can't read (no OCR fallback).

pdf_url.title: Source PDF URL
pdf_url.description: Always null on this actor — the Senate source is an HTML page, not a per-row PDF.

fetchedAt.title: Fetched at
fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this row was first pulled from source. Immutable once set — a re-fetch of an unchanged row never updates it. If the source later revises this filing row, the new row carries this timestamp forward from the prior version, so 'first seen' survives the revision.

lastModifiedAt.title: Last modified at
lastModifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this row's content was last observed to change. Equals fetchedAt for a first-seen row.

revisionCount.title: Revision count
revisionCount.description: Number of content revisions detected for this source document/row lineage. 0 for a first-seen row; incremented each time the source republishes this row with different content.

politician.title: Politician
politician.description: Filer name as it appears on the Senate disclosure.

transaction_date.title: Transaction date
transaction_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the trade was executed.

filing_date.title: Filing date
filing_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the PTR was filed with the Senate.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: Stock ticker. Null for bonds, municipal securities, structured notes, and other non-equity instruments.

asset_name.title: Asset name
asset_name.description: Full asset description as reported on the PTR.

type.title: Trade type
type.description: Normalized to 'buy' (Purchase), 'sell' (Sale Full / Sale Partial), or 'exchange' (an asset swap, e.g. a called security or merger conversion — reported by the source as its own transaction type, not a buy or sell).

amount_min.title: Amount lower bound
amount_min.description: Lower bound of the reported amount range, in USD.

amount_max.title: Amount upper bound
amount_max.description: Upper bound of the reported amount range, in USD. Null for unbounded 'Over $X' brackets.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Account owner classification per STOCK Act.

overview.title: Transaction overview
overview.description: Compact view — politician, ticker, type, amounts, dates.

full.title: Full record
full.description: All fields including asset_name, asset_type, id, source_id, content_hash, and filing_type.
